svg.title: la Portella del Pinell — illustrated terrain, view from 120 degrees
svg.desc: Terrain: ICGC MET, CC BY 4.0, transformed into an illustration. Terrain: Mapzen; Europe terrain produced using Copernicus data and information funded by the European Union — EU-DEM layers; SRTM/GMTED2010 courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey. Stylised orthographic terrain with adjusted vertical scale; not a route map. No inferred snow or trails.
